title: While the list loads, the Inactive tab never says "No inactive terms"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure at least one term is deactivated.
  • Start on the Settings page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "Credit Terms".
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab as soon as it can be clicked, before the rows appear.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page starts loading.

Step 2:

  • While the rows are still loading, the line "No inactive terms" does not show at any moment.
  • Once loaded, the inactive terms appear.

A manual tester can try step 2, but on a fast connection the loading moment is too short to judge; this part needs an automated check with a slowed network.
